title: TikSwap
tagline: A secondary ticket exchange platform built on the Chilliz Sports blockchain. It allows users to resell event tickets annonymously and transparently without need for intermediaries and scalpers disrupting the ticket resale market
description:
When tickets to games are sold out, primary ticket holders may meet circumstances that demand they forfeit or resell their tickets for a pre-planned game. 

But lack of transparency, resale bias and activity of scalpers has crushed the secondary ticket market,  destroying the game for lots of fans who watch third party tickets  become overpriced for dubious gains 

TikSwap is a Fan-zone where season long followers of events, can offer their tickets up for resale, anonymously using Zero knowledge proof to protect the information about ticket holder and ticket.

It's a simple idea. But one utmost importance to lovers of the game.  

TikSwap offers a good chance for clubs to turn their fan tokens into utility tokens, for token-gating the social fanzone and for purchasing game tickets.




TikSwap is an open ticket resale market controlled by fans and clubs in order to bring transparency and fairness to the secondary ticket market.
how_its_made:
TikSwap is deployed on chilliz’s spicy testnet., and interactions are powered using fans tokens from different fan zones such as the Arsenal fan token

Noir circuit is used to generate and verify  proofs issued for the private tickets,  these proofs can be saved on FVM via lighthouse.storage, while nullifiers and records are saved on the smart contract.
